Home › Request a trip
Roxgold SiteLife.
Requesting a trip and tracking your request.
To go on leave, the request is often made
by word of mouth or on paper.
With no recorded answer,
it is hard to know whether it was approved.
With Roxgold SiteLife, you make your request online
and track it until it is approved.
From your home screen,
tap Request a trip.
The Requests page opens.
Tap the gold bus button.
Your request will be sent
to the administration for approval.
First, choose the route.
Say where you get on
and where you get off.
The days the bus runs are shown:
here, Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
Choose the camp bus
or your own vehicle.
Then the departure date, at least 48 hours ahead,
and the date you return to camp.
Choose the reason,
add details if needed,
then tap Submit the request.
The request appears: Pending.
Until it has been handled, you can cancel it.
The administration approves it:
the status changes to Approved, with its comment.
You are informed
by a notification.
On your home screen, the trip becomes your next trip:
date, countdown and towns along the route.
A request in a few taps,
and a recorded decision.
If it is refused,
you are always told why.
Roxgold SiteLife.
Request, track, travel.
